PLAN "12-Week Postpartum Return Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Gentle postpartum recovery and gradual return to activity"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Early Recovery" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 20m "Gentle Mobility & Walking":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cat-cow 2x8 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          seated shoulder circles 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          ankle pumps 2x12 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          deep breathing 3m
      DAY Thursday training 20m "Gentle Mobility & Walking":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          seated neck stretches 2x10s rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          standing wall push 2x8 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          side-lying hip abduction 2x8 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          deep breathing 3m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 20m "Gentle Mobility & Walking":
        warmup:
          walking 7m
        main straight_sets:
          cat-cow 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          seated shoulder circles 2x12 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          ankle pumps 2x15 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          deep breathing 3m
      DAY Thursday training 20m "Gentle Mobility & Walking":
        warmup:
          walking 7m
        main straight_sets:
          seated neck stretches 2x12s rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          standing wall push 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          side-lying hip abduction 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          deep breathing 3m

  PHASE "Phase 2: Gentle Progression" (2 weeks):

          walking 8m

          side-lying hip abduction 2x12 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds

          standing calf raise 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          deep breathing 3m
    WEEK 4:

  PHASE "Phase 3: Foundation Building" (4 weeks):
